payload.feature:
Fix the research-dsh lane's effort pin so the weekly sweep can start.

Evidence: workflow run 34115364530 (2026-09-07), Research issue #234. The seat died in one second with `dsh: UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT: provider "dashscope" model "qwen3.8-max" does not support reasoning effort "high"`. The pin reaches dsh since #200 (decision 0035 addendum); before that it stopped at the digest, so this route was never exercised with an effort.

Root cause, measured on dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 and re-measured on 0.1.3-alpha.2 (identical):
1. `recipes/research-dsh/drivers/research-web.yml` declares a custom provider `dashscope` whose model entry is only `id: qwen3.8-max`. dsh-llm-pi-ai's `resolveModelReasoning` resolves a custom entry with no `reasoningEfforts` against the installed catalog for the SAME provider key; no catalog ships for `dashscope`, so the model is materialized as non-reasoning and any requested effort throws.
2. dsh's bundled catalog (pi-ai qwen-token-plan*.json) lists Qwen3.8-Max with levels low, medium, xhigh; high and max are pinned unsupported. So "high" can never be sent to this model.

The fix:
- In `recipes/research-dsh/drivers/research-web.yml`, declare the model's levels on the entry: `reasoningEfforts: {low: low, medium: medium, xhigh: xhigh}` (each declared level carries its wire value; undeclared levels stay unsupported). Keep a comment that records the measurement and why the table is stated here (no catalog for a custom route).
- In `recipes/research-dsh/bundle.json`, move the pin `--effort high` to `--effort xhigh`. xhigh is the nearest declared level to the ruled "high"; record in the README that the level is the operator's to change and why it is xhigh.
- Update `recipes/research-dsh/README.md` wherever it says effort `high`.
- The bundle digest moves: update the `recipes/research-dsh` row in `crates/brokkr-runtime/tests/witness_digests.rs` to the new digest, computed the way the test computes it. Do not touch any other digest.
- `docs/guides/provider-adapters.md` and any other prose naming the research lane's effort must agree with the new value (grep for `qwen3.8-max` and `effort`); do not edit adapters/dsh.json.
- If a decision record should carry this as an addendum (0035's addendum on dsh effort, or 0044 ruling 5's erratum on the hire), add the shortest addendum that records the measurement and the xhigh choice as an operator-rulable default. Follow the existing addendum style exactly.

Live proof already taken by the operator's session on 2026-09-08: `brokkr driver dsh -- --model dashscope/qwen3.8-max --effort xhigh --patch <the patched yml>` passed dsh's effort validation (the request header row echoed effort `xhigh`) and then failed on the provider with `QUOTA: 429 insufficient_quota` — the Model Studio token-plan weekly quota is exhausted until 2026-09-12 14:37 UTC. Do NOT run a live probe yourself; the quota is spent. Record that measurement in the README/addendum as the evidence, and note that the weekly workflow cannot succeed before the quota resets regardless of this fix.

Verification: the workspace tests pass (`cargo test -p brokkr-runtime --test witness_digests` at minimum plus the crate suites); `dsh --profile headless --dump-default-config` is not needed. If dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 and DASHSCOPE_API_KEY are available locally (~/.dsh/dashscope.env), a one-turn `brokkr driver dsh -- --model dashscope/qwen3.8-max --effort xhigh --patch recipes/research-dsh/drivers/research-web.yml` probe that shows `xhigh` on the request header is the proof; if not available, say so plainly in the notes rather than claiming it.

house.content:
This realm is a Rust workspace. Production code is Rust under `crates/`; the
Rust-only architecture is recorded by decision 0009. Semantic changes carry a
decision document with status `proposed` because only the operator accepts one.
Intake seats read `README.md` and decisions 0004 and 0005 before framing a
commission, along with the code and history it touches.

The frozen v1 contracts under `contracts/`, the production table at
`policy/phase-machine.json`, `policy/schemas/`, and `reference/` are read-only.
A contract change lands as a new version file beside the old one, never as an
edit. The evaluator corpus under `fixtures/` is also frozen and is never
regenerated, only versioned.

Tests are part of every change. Extend the suite that proves the code, run
`cargo test --workspace`, compile `bundles/self`, and leave formatting, clippy,
and the exact-coverage gate clean before reporting success.

Commit completed work with `git` using the repository's message style. Never
push.

result.notes: Committed bc9f487 (signed, steward key) on slice-research-effort-pin, not pushed. recipes/research-dsh/drivers/research-web.yml now declares reasoningEfforts {low, medium, xhigh} on the qwen3.8-max entry with a comment recording the measurement (no catalog for a custom dashscope route; high/max unsupported in dsh's Qwen catalog); bundle.json pins --effort xhigh; the README's head paragraph says xhigh and a new section records why, that the level is the operator's to change, and the 2026-09-08 proof (xhigh echoed on the request header, then QUOTA 429; weekly sweep cannot succeed before 2026-09-12 14:37 UTC). witness_digests.rs: only the recipes/research-dsh row moved, to the digest the test itself computed. docs/guides/provider-adapters.md gains one passage on custom routes stating their levels. Decision 0035 gains a second addendum (2026-09-08, proposed) in the existing addendum style with measurement, rulings (xhigh as operator-rulable default), and enforcement binding; 0044 ruling 5 left untouched since it names no effort. adapters/dsh.json untouched; the brokkr-protocol unit test that pins --effort high against the shim is a mechanism test, not the lane, and stays. Verified: cargo test --workspace green (36 binaries, no failures), cargo fmt --check clean, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, brokkr compile --bundle bundles/self and recipes/research-dsh both compile, overlay YAML parses with the levels nested under the model entry. No live dsh probe was run, per the framing; dsh is on PATH but its version was not checked.

cargo test --workspace: 60 successful test-suite summaries, 0 failed; cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- compile --bundle bundles/self: 1 bundle compiled, 0 failed (offline from the bound Cargo registry cache)

Reviewed bc9f487 (the run's only commit) against the framing. Correctness: the overlay entry declares reasoningEfforts {low,medium,xhigh} with wire values and leaves high/max undeclared; bundle.json pins --effort xhigh; only the recipes/research-dsh digest row moved and cargo test -p brokkr-runtime --test witness_digests passes with it, so the digest is the test's own computation; README, provider-adapters guide and a second 0035 addendum (heading/Rulings/Enforcement-binding style matches the 2026-09-05 addendum) agree on xhigh and record the 2026-09-08 operator probe (xhigh echoed on the request header, then QUOTA 429; quota resets 2026-09-12 14:37 UTC). Grepped every mention of qwen3.8-max, dashscope and effort across docs, recipes, workflows, agents and CONTRIBUTING: no prose still names the lane's effort as high (remaining 'high' hits are unit-test argv fixtures for the forwarding seam, not the lane). cargo test -p brokkr-runtime -p brokkr-protocol: all green; cargo fmt --check clean. No live probe run, per the framing (quota spent); the operator's session measurement is the only wire evidence and is recorded as such. Simplicity: no code beyond the digest constant; the measurement narrative is repeated in four places (yml comment, README, guide, addendum), which is house style. Security: none. apiKeyEnv is unchanged and holds no value; the argv delta is a literal level; the overlay is inside the witness digest so a tampered level table fails the pinned-digest test; undeclared levels stay refused, so fail-closed is preserved. Residual findings: [info] recipes/research-dsh/README.md:27 and drivers/research-web.yml:15 (and 0044 ruling 5's erratum) still say the overlay 'carries only the route', which is no longer literally true now the entry also carries its level table; the README's own later section states the new fact, so this is a stale phrase, not a wrong claim. [info] docs/guides/recipe-authoring.md's sample `brokkr recipes list` block shows recipe digests that predate this change (and lacks standby); it was already stale before this run and is illustrative, noted only so nobody reads it as the current digest.
